source.publisher: Newry Reporter (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: names read from the page image; returned unopposed, no poll

note: Triennial election of the county council, 1908: polled 27 May 1908 in twelve divisions; the other nine (ten seats) returned unopposed, Killeavy by the sitting member being deemed re-elected for want of a nomination. Returned unopposed. No nomination: "the sitting member, Mr. John M'Cann, Lathbirget (anti-direct labour), will, therefore, be declared to be deemed re-elected". Printed "Killevy".
